description: Eight sample players on one panel. Each row holds a bank of samples and plays one of them at a speed tracking one volt per octave, with its own level, pan and stereo outputs

notes: a row plays nothing until its bank holds samples; drag audio files onto the module, and every playable audio file found in the folder is listed as that row's bank
dragging a playhead with the alt key held moves it with granular playback, and dragging with shift held scratches it, the pitch following the speed of the drag
menu: Exclusive Play Mode — only one row plays at a time
Output 0V when stopped — a row puts out 0V while its sample is stopped or paused, rather than holding the last voltage
BUSY MODE — a start trigger on a row is taken only while that row is not already playing
NAMES more visible — draws the sample names on the displays more strongly
